The artist

Built from the streets.
Made for the stage.

King Gozila, also known as Shatta San, is a Ghanaian Dancehall artist with an Afro-Dancehall sound, bold delivery and a message of ambition, resilience and self-belief. This is the official home for new releases, visuals, performances and updates.
